messages.subject: Can't compute SE when including residual correlations
parts:
Dear all,

I am receiving the following lavaan warning:

Could not compute standard errors! The information matrix could not be inverted. This may be a symptom that the model is not identified.

When trying to converge the following model:

m1 <- '       pp ~ l_pref_edu1 + l_pref_edu2 + l_pref_edu3 + l_pp
              pref_edu1 ~ pp + l_pref_edu1        
              pref_edu2 ~ pp + l_pref_edu2  
              pref_edu3 ~ pp + l_pref_edu3  
             
              l_pref_edu1 ~~ pref_edu1
              l_pref_edu2 ~~ pref_edu2
              l_pref_edu3 ~~ pref_edu3
              l_pp ~~ pp
'
fit1<-sem(m1, data = temp_mj)
summary(fit1, standardized = TRUE)

I do not receive any error when I remove the residual correlations:

m2 <- '       pp ~ l_pref_edu1 + l_pref_edu2 + l_pref_edu3 + l_pp
              pref_edu1 ~ pp + l_pref_edu1        
              pref_edu2 ~ pp + l_pref_edu2  
              pref_edu3 ~ pp + l_pref_edu3  
              '
fit2<-sem(m2, data = temp_mj)
summary(fit2, standardized = TRUE)

Could anyone help me identify what's going one here?

Here are the two outputs:

In model 1, it looks like you have l_pp BOTH predicting pp and covarying with pp. Those two coefficients use the same information, so you can't do both.
